call_points.text: HALS revenue targeted at ₹250-300 Cr this year, about 30-35% of overall revenue growth.
Geneus Chem collaboration expected to add ₹300-350 Cr cumulative revenue over 3-4 years.
Geneus Chem NOR HALS plant to start in Q3FY27 with about ₹25 Cr capex.
Hydroquinone and catechol plant stabilised; customer approvals received, revenue to start from August-September.
₹100 Cr capital infused into Clean Fino Chem in Q1; total investment now ~₹850 Cr.
EBITDA margins expected to keep improving as higher-grade HALS sales rise and operating efficiencies kick in.
Raw-material price volatility from Middle East crisis and crude oil remains a profitability concern.
Management could not confirm supply-chain security, saying 'I'm not so confident that it is locked'.
Netherlands subsidiary to start mid-September and serve European demand.
Performance Chemical 2 capex timeline is on track to commercialize by September 2026.
Subsidiary Clean Fino-Chem reported positive EBITDA of ₹7 crores in Q4, marking its first profitable quarter.
Incurred total capex of ~Rs. 220 crores during FY2026 primarily towards investment in Clean Fino Chem Ltd.
Executive Directors voluntarily elected to forgo a substantial portion of their performance bonus entitlement for FY 2026.
Board approved a final dividend of Rs. 4 per share, implying a total payout ratio for the year of 25%.
Planned capex on track for commercialising new series of products.
The HALS facility is housed in wholly owned subsidiary Clean Fino Chem Ltd. at Kurkumbh Industrial Area, Maharashtra.

operating_notes.text: Consolidated capital work-in-progress rose to ₹118 Cr at 31-March-2026 from ₹30 Cr a year earlier.
The HALS facility in Clean Fino Chem was commercialised in March 2024 and carries a tax incentive.
Exports were over 61% of consolidated revenues.
HALS volumes were about 1,000 tonnes in Q1FY27, with average realisation rising from ~440 to ~550 on a better product mix.
HALS capacity is about 10,000 tonnes, split roughly 40% lower grade and 60% higher grade.
Standalone domestic-export mix was 65:35 in Q1FY27.

timeline.summary: Clean Science reported FY26 standalone revenue of ₹815.34 Cr, recommended a ₹4 final dividend, and approved a ₹200 Cr subsidiary investment.
Clean Science released its investor presentation for Q4 FY26 and FY26, highlighting ₹220 Cr capex and stable margins.
AAB Business Trust announced a proposed inter-se gift transfer of 9.5% promoter shares in Clean Science.
Clean Science Q1FY27 consolidated revenue rose 10% YoY to ₹264 Cr, highest ever, with HALS at 22% of sales; announced Geneus Chem collaboration and 5-year Kemin supply contract.

Clean Science and Technology Limited scheduled a conference call on **31 October 2026 at 16:00 IST** for analysts and investors to discuss unaudited Q2FY27 results, led by **Siddhartha Sikchi (Promoter & MD), Sanjay Parnerkar (CFO), and Pratik Bora (President, Commercial)**.
